name: Canvas count
summary: The answer count on a slide canvas: how many answered correctly and incorrectly (✓ 12 · ✗ 3), or how many answered with no verdict, in one small deck container.
highlights: Correct / incorrect count, or answered only
40px deck container: fill, no stroke, radius 8, frosted on photo decks
Inked by applyCanvasDeck, so it reads on white and black ink
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-canvas-count> — for the count many slide types show on the presenter canvas. Set `correct` and `wrong` for the verdict form (a green check disc, the count and a person glyph, a divider, a red cross disc, the count and a person glyph), or `answered` alone for the answered-only form (the count and a person glyph). Its container is the deck container set applyCanvasDeck writes (--aha-deck-container-fill / -radius-sm / -padding-*), so the same element reads on a light deck, a dark deck and a photo deck with no props.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks. Attributes only, no events.

spec.label: Container
spec.value: 40px tall, radius 8 (--aha-deck-container-radius-sm), padding 8 / 16 / 8 / 8 (--aha-space-8 on the disc side, --aha-space-16 on the glyph side; 16 both sides when answered only), --aha-deck-container-fill with no stroke, backdrop blur --aha-blur-md

spec.label: Verdict
spec.value: 20px disc in --aha-answer-correct with a white system-check 12 · count · system-user 16 · 1px divider (--aha-deck-stroke) · 20px disc in --aha-answer-wrong with a white system-x 12 · count · system-user 16; 6px inside a part, 8px between parts

spec.label: Answered only
spec.value: count · system-user 16, no disc and no divider

spec.label: Type
spec.value: count 16px / 600, tabular figures, in the deck ink; the person glyph in --aha-deck-ink-secondary (76%)

spec.label: Deck
spec.value: solid deck: the ink at 8% fill, no stroke; photo deck (applyCanvasDeck image: true): the opposite of the ink at 80% (white under black ink, near-black under white ink)

props.name: correct
props.desc: How many answered correctly. Setting it (or `wrong`) shows the verdict form

props.name: answered
props.desc: How many answered, shown when neither `correct` nor `wrong` is set

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name of the group; pass a translated string in the product

whenToUse.when: a quiz-style slide on the presenter canvas once answers are revealed: how many got it right and wrong
a slide with no right answer (poll, rating, word cloud) that still shows how many answered next to the result
while answers are still coming in: the status line as free-floating text

opinion.note: Never rebuild it as a hand-rolled pill: the deck container set keeps every count on every slide type the same size, radius and fill. Never colour the container with the accent; the only colour is the two verdict discs.

a11y.role: role="group" with an accessible name that states the whole count; the visual parts are aria-hidden so each number is read once

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The probe is the verdict form on a white stage with no deck applied, so every value is its DS fallback.

selfCheck.label: container from the deck container set (fill, no stroke, radius 8, padding 8 / 16)
verdict discs in --aha-answer-correct / --aha-answer-wrong with DS glyphs
answered-only form has no verdict mark
one accessible name for the whole count, observed
